caption:
Cheat’s Green Thai Curry

Ingredients 
-5 cloves of garlic, chopped 
-1 onion, sliced
-200 grams button mushroom, quartered
-1 capsicum, sliced
-450 grams chicken breast, chopped in cubes
-50 grams Thai green curry paste
-150 ml coconut milk
-100 ml water

Method
-add ghee to the pan followed by the garlic
-add in the sliced onions and cook till translucent 
-add in your mushrooms and cook, follow it up with capsicum
-move the cooked Veges to create space in the middle of the pan
-add in your curry paste + 2 tbsp water
-add in the chicken and sauté
-add coconut milk and water 
-cover and allow to cook for 20 mins or until chicken is cooked through remember to keep stiring every few minutes 
-enjoy with noodles or rice
